about.title: About me
about.description: Engineering software experience shaped by hands-on development and enterprise architecture.
about.lead: I combine deep engineering software development knowledge with enterprise architecture and modern software technologies.

sections.heading: From geometry to enterprise systems
sections.body: My professional journey began with hands-on CAD software development: geometry algorithms, model comparison, custom feature development and engineering automation. Over time, that foundation expanded into enterprise PLM architecture, 3DEXPERIENCE development, systems integration and technical leadership.

sections.heading: How I work
sections.body: I enjoy understanding complex engineering problems, building prototypes and transforming promising ideas into working applications. Practical implementation experience helps me design architectures grounded in the realities of engineering software.

cad-development.title: CAD development
cad-development.description: CATIA V5 development, geometric algorithms and engineering automation.
cad-development.lead: Extending CAD applications with custom functionality, geometric processing and automation.

sections.heading: CATIA V5 and CAA
sections.body: Experience includes custom feature development, application extensions, geometry creation and modification, and engineering workflow automation using C++ and CAA.

sections.heading: Geometry analysis
sections.body: CAD model analysis and geometry comparison work supports the review of engineering changes and design validation. Specific comparison algorithms and implementation results should be added only after verification.

3dexperience-plm.title: 3DEXPERIENCE & PLM
3dexperience-plm.description: Enterprise PLM solution architecture, development and integration.
3dexperience-plm.lead: Connecting engineering applications, data and processes across the product lifecycle.

sections.heading: Platform and architecture
sections.body: Experience spans 3DEXPERIENCE solution architecture and customization, engineering data management, product structures, platform deployment and technical troubleshooting.

sections.heading: Integration perspective
sections.body: Work includes engineering data exchange, PLM-to-ERP integration, EBOM/MBOM flows, SAP integration, Teamcenter interoperability, MBSE workflows and technical migration planning.

ai-innovation.title: AI innovation
ai-innovation.description: Exploring AI-assisted engineering workflows and natural-language CAD automation.
ai-innovation.lead: Investigating how language models and native engineering APIs can make repetitive CAD work more accessible.

sections.heading: Natural language to CAD
sections.body: A prototype explores a controlled sequence: interpret a request, generate a structured JSON plan, validate it, execute supported operations through CAA, and return feedback.

sections.heading: Prototype-first approach
sections.body: The focus is on technical feasibility, explicit execution feedback and practical integration with engineering software—not claims of autonomous production-ready design.

software-projects.title: Software projects
software-projects.description: Independent full-stack and distributed application projects.
software-projects.lead: A practical software engineering background across web applications, distributed systems and data workflows.

sections.heading: Full stack applications
sections.body: Independent projects include a medical workflow management application and personal cloud file management, built with Node.js, Express, relational databases and server-rendered interfaces.

sections.heading: Distributed systems
sections.body: A distributed job execution and monitoring concept explored socket communication, job state, process tracking, database-backed records and web administration.

sections.heading: Technical leadership
